name: Dblog JSON Viewer
description: Enhanced JSON viewer for Drupal dblog messages with search, fullscreen and more features.
project_description: Dblog JSON Viewer is a client-side enhancement for Drupal's core Database Logging (dblog) event page. On any '/admin/reports/dblog/event/*' page it detects JSON content in the log message cell and replaces the plain-text dump with an interactive, syntax-highlighted, collapsible tree using the bundled json-view library, plus real-time search with previous/next navigation, expand/collapse-all controls, a formatted-vs-raw toggle, copy-to-clipboard, and a fullscreen mode. Detection is heuristic: the JavaScript strips the cell's HTML back to text, extracts one or more JSON objects (including multi-section 'Options:'/'Response:'/'Headers:' style API logs and nested JSON-in-string values), and scores candidates by complexity and by configurable 'API key' patterns to pick the most relevant object. Everything is rendered in the browser; the module ships no entities, services, plugins, or Drush commands. A single settings form at Administration > Configuration > Development > Dblog JSON Viewer lets administrators customise every button/label string, the search debounce delay, a debug-logging toggle, and the API-key and section pattern lists. The library is attached only on the dblog event route and only for users holding 'access site reports' or 'administer site configuration'.
